sources.quote:
How I want the beta calendar built for the four buy weeks. The rules stay here; the calls are yours.
Span and time base
The calendar covers Mon Oct 6 00:00 UTC to Sun Nov 2 23:59 UTC, the four buy weeks in my UA plan. Every window is stated in server time (UTC) as a start-end instant. A PT/PDT rendering of the same instant is fine, a different instant is not.
Scope
Every ZM3D beat a player can see in those weeks: an event window, a reset or a start push. Not only the events everyone lists. Boss Arena is off this calendar until the pivot call.
When a beat starts
A beat starts with the first window that opens after its server windows are live on prod, the backend release instant read in UTC, not when its client PRs merged. Collect & Win runs Mon-Tue, Wed-Thu and Fri-Sun, each opening 00:00 UTC, so a window the release instant pre-empts does not count. A beat that is only waiting on that release starts late, it is not held. Season Pass seasons open on the 1st at 00:00 UTC. For the quest rollover, the daily gift (the Login Calendar row on the push sheet) and Plague Race put down whether the beat is in and whether its push is ready, not its window dates.
Held or not
Hold a beat only when players provably cannot enter, score or claim on prod even after a restart. An established failure holds it; an unverified build or platform is a still-to-do, not a hold. Wrong counters, a reset that needs a restart, cosmetic, VFX and performance gaps and analytics gaps do not hold a beat, and neither does a change request outside the Aug-Sep live-ops cohort. An unresolved change-request review blocker on an in-scope live-ops PR from that cohort does hold it. A hold with no dated fix runs until the fix is confirmed on prod; say that instead of guessing a date.
One-offs
One-offs may overlap recurring beat slots. A one-off may take a recurring beat slot only with the latest dated approval from Product, and if he takes that back his later word is the one that counts.
Still to do
For each beat, what still has to land before it runs for bought users (prod deploy, config, player-facing art an owner has flagged) and who owns it. Not what already shipped, not analytics, not polish nobody flagged.
Push copy
A push goes out only if its row is Ready and LIVE and its English copy names the game only as Zombie Match 3D and events only by their ZM3D names. Anything else is held, with what is missing. Beta pushes are English-only (UK and US buys); the translated tab is the old Domino set still waiting on ZM3D localization.
Config locks
Every config a beat needs lands before its lock, read in server time (UTC). A committed date that misses the lock moves earlier and its owner is told in a reply on the mail where they committed to it.
